title: Whereabouts of singer Lurlene Hunter
summary: Lurlene Hunter, a wonderful singer, left music and lives in Three Rivers, Michigan.

blocks.x: Lurlene is in -- I think she's in -- here in Three Rivers, Michigan. She just completely gave up on music.
